whoBody: MyTracker is an app for logging food and workouts.
collectIntro: Today the app collects only the following.
account: Account details: your name, email, and a password stored by the server.
camera: Camera: used to scan product barcodes.
photos: Photos you choose for body-fat records.
healthRead: Health data we read: steps, active calories, distance, and flights climbed.
healthWrite: Health data we write: body weight, only when you log a weight.
messages: Messages, including text and media, between a trainer and a trainee.
whyBody: To run the diary, workouts, and progress features you asked for.
notBody: We do not sell this data and we do not use it for advertising.
deleteBody: You can delete your account inside the app, from your profile. That deletion removes the account and the data attached to it.
changesBody: If a new feature needs data that is not listed here, this page is updated first and the date above changes.
